description.en: Five statements about how you've been feeling over the last two weeks, from the World Health Organization. Higher is better.
description.ar: خمس عبارات عن شعورك خلال الأسبوعين الماضيين، من منظمة الصحة العالمية. كلما ارتفعت النتيجة كان ذلك أفضل.

source.citation: World Health Organization. The World Health Organization-Five Well-Being Index (WHO-5). Geneva: WHO; 2024. Arabic: the 1999 translation (Psychiatric Research Unit, Hillerød; © WHO Collaborating Center, Psykiatrisk Forskningsenhed, Psykiatrisk Sygehus, Hillerød), as republished by WHO. It was completed before WHO accepted copyright of the English version in 2024; WHO is not responsible for its content or accuracy, and where they differ the English version is binding. Spelling normalised (hamzas, tanween) and one agreement fixed («مليئا» → «مليئة»), wording unchanged.

instructions.en: For each statement, choose what is closest to how you have been feeling over the last two weeks.
instructions.ar: لكل من العبارات الخمس التالية، اختر ما هو أقرب من كيفما شعرت في الأسبوعين الماضيين. لاحظ بأن درجة أعلى هي لأفضل حالة.

en: Less than half of the time
More than half of the time

description.en: Your wellbeing over the last two weeks, from 0 to 100.
description.ar: رفاهك النفسي خلال الأسبوعين الماضيين، من ٠ إلى ١٠٠.

text.en: I have felt cheerful and in good spirits
I have felt calm and relaxed
I have felt active and vigorous
I woke up feeling fresh and rested
My daily life has been filled with things that interest me
text.ar: كانت أيامي مليئة بأشياء محببة لنفسي

description.en: Below 50 suggests it's worth checking in with a professional about how you've been.
description.ar: النتيجة الأقل من ٥٠ تعني أنه من المفيد أن تتحدث مع مختص عن حالك مؤخراً.

description.en: You've been feeling fairly well lately. Keep doing what helps.
description.ar: كنت تشعر بحال جيدة إلى حد ما مؤخراً. استمر فيما يساعدك.
